answer_1.quote: A number of recent studies propose using summarisation systems to automatically generate consultation notes from the verbatim transcript of the consultation—a task henceforth referred to as Note Generation.

answer_2.quote: We carry out a correlation study of automatic metrics for the task of Note Generation. A total of 18 automatic metrics are tested against statistics produced by the human judgements.

answer_4.quote: Our contributions are: (i) a large‑scale human evaluation performed by 5 clinicians on a set of 285 consultation notes … The evaluation tasks include post‑editing notes, classifying errors into ‘incorrect statements’ and ‘omissions’, and providing qualitative feedback.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators listened to the audio, post‑edited each generated note, marked spans for incorrect statements and omissions, and recorded any other issues.
